name: Steve Chen
title: Trustee, Los Gatos-Saratoga Union High School District
years_of_service: Elected to the Los Gatos-Saratoga Union High School District Board of Trustees in 2022; current term expires 2026, per the district's board directory.
background: Chen holds a Stanford University degree in electrical engineering. He spent 30 years in technology sales and marketing before earning a master's degree in education from Santa Clara University in 2015.

He taught mathematics at Los Gatos High School until his retirement in June 2022. He has been a downtown Los Gatos resident since 1993 and raised three children in the district; the district's board directory quotes him citing public education as central to community identity.

As Trustee, he is listed as a co-sponsor of Measure N, a $321,000,000 facilities bond covering Los Gatos High School and Saratoga High School, placed on the November 3, 2026 ballot; full detail on that measure is covered in content/measures/scc-measure-n-2026.json and not duplicated here.
attendance: No individually published meeting-attendance or voting-participation record for Trustee Chen was found. Los Gatos-Saratoga Union High School District does not appear to publish a per-trustee attendance scorecard on its public board pages; board agendas and minutes are posted but were not tallied individually within this session's tool budget.

past_measures_authored.title: Measure N, Los Gatos-Saratoga Union High School District School Bonds
past_measures_authored.outcome: On the November 3, 2026 ballot; outcome not yet known at time of writing.
